entries.name: AlphaRAR.aRTSFE_clt_joint
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_4 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, α < 1 → ∀ {K : NNReal} (hlip : LipschitzWith K T), (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → ∀ (G : Matrix 𝓐 𝓐 ℝ), HasFDerivAt (fun x => WithLp.toLp 2 (T x.ofLp)) (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM G) (WithLp.toLp 2 ν.means) → ∀ {hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, AlphaRAR.IsExplorationSchedule hsched → AlphaRAR.IsSqrtSmall hsched → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬AlphaRAR.aRTSFEUnder A Y θ₀ T hsched k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (AlphaRAR.jointSqrtNVec ν A Y θ₀ T (T ν.means) n) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.fromBlocks ((G * Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) / T ν.means a) * G.transpose) ((G * Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) / T ν.means a) * G.transpose) ((G * Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) / T ν.means a) * G.transpose) ((G * Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) / T ν.means a) * G.transpose)), ⋯⟩)

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_3 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, α < 1 → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → DifferentiableAt ℝ T ν.means → ∀ {hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, AlphaRAR.IsExplorationSchedule hsched → AlphaRAR.IsSqrtSmall hsched → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬AlphaRAR.aRTSFEUnder A Y θ₀ T hsched k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) - ↑n * T ν.means k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.condExp_sq_wIncr
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (w : 𝓐 → ℝ) (i : ℕ), P[fun ω => AlphaRAR.wIncr ν A Y w i ω ^ 2 | ↑(Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationAction ⋯ ⋯) i] =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ a, w a ^ 2 * (Learning.armIndicator A a i ω * ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.condExp_wIncr
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (w : 𝓐 → ℝ) (i : ℕ), P[AlphaRAR.wIncr ν A Y w i | ↑(Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationAction ⋯ ⋯) i] =ᵐ[P] 0

entries.name: AlphaRAR.consistency_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] {Y r : ℕ → Ω → ι → ℝ} {u : Ω → ι → ℝ}, (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (j : ℕ), ∑ k, Y j ω k = 1) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k, r n ω k = 1) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => max (AlphaRAR.count (fun x => Y x ω k) n / ↑n - r n ω k) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x => r x ω k) Filter.atTop (nhds (u ω k))) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (k : ι), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun x => Y x ω k) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (u ω k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.consistency_of_generic_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] {Y pp r : ℕ → Ω → ι → ℝ} {u : Ω → ι → ℝ} {α C : ℝ} {ℓ : ι → Ω → ℕ → ℕ}, α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (j : ℕ), ∑ k, Y j ω k = 1) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k, r n ω k = 1) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), ℓ k ω n ≤ n) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, u ω k ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x => r x ω k) Filter.atTop (nhds (u ω k))) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.assignMG (fun x => Y x ω k) (fun x => pp x ω k) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.count (fun x => Y x ω k) n - ↑n * r n ω k ≤ C + (AlphaRAR.count (fun x => Y x ω k) (ℓ k ω n) - ↑(ℓ k ω n) * r (ℓ k ω n) ω k) + (AlphaRAR.auxU (fun x => Y x ω k) (fun x => pp x ω k) (fun x => r x ω k) α n - AlphaRAR.auxU (fun x => Y x ω k) (fun x => pp x ω k) (fun x => r x ω k) α (ℓ k ω n))) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (AlphaRAR.count (fun x => Y x ω k) (ℓ k ω n) - ↑(ℓ k ω n) * r (ℓ k ω n) ω k) / ↑n < δ) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (k : ι), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun x => Y x ω k) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (u ω k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.consistency_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst_3 : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) ω k) / ↑n < δ) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ u, ∀ (k : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T n ω k) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.count_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (X p : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.count X n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, p m + AlphaRAR.assignMG X p n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.count_indicator_eq_pullCount

entries.name: AlphaRAR.count_proportion_pos_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ}, Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ {α : ℝ}, α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) ω k) / ↑n < δ) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ uk, 0 < uk ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds uk)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.count_sub_smul_ae_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_3 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, α < 1 → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n k'' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k'') n) Filter.atTop (nhds ν.means)) → ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst_4 : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k' : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => T (fun k'' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k'') n) k' - T ν.means k') =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) / ↑n) → (∀ (k' : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ C, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) ω k' ≤ C * √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) - ↑n * T ν.means k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.count_succ

entries.name: AlphaRAR.dTrackingProb_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_1 : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_2 : Nonempty 𝓐] (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → ∀ {α : ℝ}, α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : ↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ AlphaRAR.dTrackingProb θ₀ T α n h k

entries.name: AlphaRAR.dTrackingProb_throttle
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_1 : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_2 : Nonempty 𝓐] (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ (α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (h : ↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × ℝ) (k : 𝓐), (↑n + 1) * AlphaRAR.histTarget θ₀ T k n h < ↑(Learning.pullCount' n h k) → AlphaRAR.dTrackingProb θ₀ T α n h k ≤ α * AlphaRAR.histTarget θ₀ T k n h

entries.name: AlphaRAR.dev_upper_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, α < 1 → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n k'' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k'') n) Filter.atTop (nhds ν.means)) → ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst_2 : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → ∀ (k' : 𝓐), (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => T (fun k'' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k'') n) k' - T ν.means k') =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) / ↑n) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ C, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) ω k' ≤ C * √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ C, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) n - ↑n * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T n ω k' ≤ C * √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.diff_U_decomp
entries.statement: ∀ (X p ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {v : ℝ}, Filter.Tendsto ρ Filter.atTop (nhds v) → ∀ {ℓ : ℕ → ℕ}, (∀ (n : ℕ), ℓ n ≤ n) → ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, |AlphaRAR.auxU X p ρ α n - AlphaRAR.auxU X p ρ α (ℓ n) - ((↑n - ↑(ℓ n)) * (-(1 - α) * v) + (AlphaRAR.assignMG X p n - AlphaRAR.assignMG X p (ℓ n)) + ↑(ℓ n) * (ρ (ℓ n) - ρ n))| ≤ ε * (↑n - ↑(ℓ n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.ell_rho_control
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] {rhoterm d : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {θdiff g h Qinc : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {Qvinc Qwinc : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {L : ℝ}, 0 ≤ L → (∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), rhoterm n ω ≤ L * ∑ k, θdiff k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), θdiff k n ω ≤ g k n ω * d n ω + h k n ω * Qinc k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ (g k)) → (∀ (k : ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ h k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsBigOpOne μ (h k)) → (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (k : ι) (ω : Ω), Qinc k n ω ≤ Qvinc n ω * d n ω + Qwinc n ω) → AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ Qvinc → (AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => Qwinc n ω / √↑n) → ∃ Vρ Wρ, (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (ω : Ω), rhoterm n ω ≤ Vρ n ω * d n ω + Wρ n ω) ∧ AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ Vρ ∧ AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => Wρ n ω / √↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimatorError_joint_tendsto_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_4 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {cn : 𝓐 → ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ cn a n) → (∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (cn a) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) → ∀ {v : 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐), 0 < v a) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n / cn a n) Filter.atTop (nhds (v a))) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 fun k => √(AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n) * (AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k) n - ν.means k)) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a)), ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimatorSqrtNVec_joint_tendsto_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_4 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {v : 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐), 0 < v a) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (v a))) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (AlphaRAR.estimatorSqrtNVec ν A Y θ₀ n) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) / v a), ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_ae_tendsto
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (k : 𝓐), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : ℝ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ L, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) θ₀ n) Filter.atTop (nhds L)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_ae_tendsto_of_pullCount_atTop
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (k : 𝓐), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : ℝ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) θ₀ n) Filter.atTop (nhds (ν.means k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_ae_tendsto_pi
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ z, ∀ (k : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k) n) Filter.atTop (nhds (z k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_diff_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (X ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (θ θ₀ : ℝ) (ℓ n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.count X ℓ + 1 ≠ 0 → AlphaRAR.count X n + 1 ≠ 0 → AlphaRAR.estimator X ξ θ₀ ℓ - AlphaRAR.estimator X ξ θ₀ n = (AlphaRAR.respMG X ξ θ ℓ + (θ₀ - θ)) * (AlphaRAR.count X n - AlphaRAR.count X ℓ) / ((AlphaRAR.count X ℓ + 1) * (AlphaRAR.count X n + 1)) - (AlphaRAR.respMG X ξ θ n - AlphaRAR.respMG X ξ θ ℓ) / (AlphaRAR.count X n + 1)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k) t = (Learning.sumRewards A Y k t ω + θ₀ k) / (↑(Learning.pullCount A k t ω) + 1)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_limit_mem_attainableSet
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (k : 𝓐) (θ₀ : ℝ) {ω : Ω} {L : ℝ}, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) θ₀ n) Filter.atTop (nhds L) → L ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y θ₀ k

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_sqrtN_anscombe_tendsto
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (k : 𝓐), (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, {j | A j ω = k}.Infinite) → MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν k) → ∀ (θ₀ : ℝ) {c : ℕ → ℕ}, Filter.Tendsto c Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) / ↑(c n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => √↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) * (AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) θ₀ n - ν.means k)) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k)).toNNReal, ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_sqrtN_joint_tendsto_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_4 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {v : 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐), 0 < v a) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (v a))) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 fun k => √↑n * (AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k) n - ν.means k)) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) / v a), ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.estimator_sub_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (X ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (θ θ₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.count X n + 1 ≠ 0 → AlphaRAR.estimator X ξ θ₀ n - θ = (AlphaRAR.respMG X ξ θ n + (θ₀ - θ)) / (AlphaRAR.count X n + 1)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_bounded_of_eventually_const
entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a (n + 1) = a n) → ∃ C, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, |a n| ≤ C

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_mul_add_two_le_two_pow
entries.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ), ∀ᶠ (k : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a * (↑k + 2) ≤ 2 ^ k

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_mul_loglog_div_lt_of_star
entries.statement: ∀ {hsched L : ℕ → ℝ} (Cq : ℝ), (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < L m ∧ 0 < hsched m) → Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ↑m * Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / (L m * hsched m)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, Cq * (Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m) < hsched m / ↑m

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_natCast_div_add_one_le
entries.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ → ℝ} {v : ℝ}, 0 < v → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => N n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds v) → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑n / (N n + 1) ≤ 2 / v

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_one_le_logLogRate
entries.statement: ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ AlphaRAR.logLogRate n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_one_le_sqrt_mul_log_log
entries.statement: ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.eventually_schedShift_le_pullCount
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_1 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, AlphaRAR.IsExplorationSchedule hsched → (∀ (m : ℕ), (∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → ↑(Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω) ≤ hsched m ∧ ∀ (j : 𝓐), ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m → Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A j m ω) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, hsched (n - (Fintype.card 𝓐 * ⌈hsched n⌉₊ + 1)) ≤ ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.exists_aRTSTarget_le_loglog_of_contDiffAt
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ} {k : 𝓐} {C : ℝ} {L : ℕ → ℝ}, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => T x k) ν.means → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), 0 ≤ T z k) → T ν.means k = 0 → (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m) → Filter.Tendsto (fun m => Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → (∀ (j : 𝓐), ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, |AlphaRAR.estimator (fun i => Learning.armIndicator A j i ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ j) m - ν.means j| ≤ C * √(Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m)) → ∃ Cq, 0 ≤ Cq ∧ ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k ≤ Cq * (Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.exists_aRTSTarget_le_mul_sum_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ} {k : 𝓐}, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => T x k) ν.means → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), 0 ≤ T z k) → T ν.means k = 0 → (∀ (j : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun m => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun i => Learning.armIndicator A j i ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ j) m) Filter.atTop (nhds (ν.means j))) → ∃ Cq, 0 ≤ Cq ∧ ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k ≤ Cq * ∑ j, (AlphaRAR.estimator (fun i => Learning.armIndicator A j i ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ j) m - ν.means j) ^ 2

entries.name: AlphaRAR.exists_decay_of_contDiffAt
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ} {k : 𝓐} {C : ℝ} {L hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => T x k) ν.means → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), 0 ≤ T z k) → T ν.means k = 0 → (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m) → Filter.Tendsto (fun m => Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < L m ∧ 0 < hsched m) → Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ↑m * Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / (L m * hsched m)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → (∀ (j : 𝓐), ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, |AlphaRAR.estimator (fun i => Learning.armIndicator A j i ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ j) m - ν.means j| ≤ C * √(Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m)) → ∃ g, (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k ≤ g m) ∧ ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, g m < hsched m / ↑m

entries.name: AlphaRAR.exists_eventually_norm_sub_fderiv_le_mul_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {θ : E}, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f θ → ∃ K, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ᶠ (x : E) in nhds θ, ‖f x - f θ - (fderiv ℝ f θ) (x - θ)‖ ≤ K * ‖x - θ‖ ^ 2

entries.name: AlphaRAR.exists_rate_loglog_of_pullCount_ge
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {L : ℕ → ℝ}, Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → (∀ (j : 𝓐), ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, L m ≤ ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω)) → (∀ (j : 𝓐), ∃ C', ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, |AlphaRAR.estimator (fun i => Learning.armIndicator A j i ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ j) m - ν.means j| ≤ C' * √(Real.log (Real.log ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω)) / ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω))) → ∃ C, ∀ (j : 𝓐), ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, |AlphaRAR.estimator (fun i => Learning.armIndicator A j i ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ j) m - ν.means j| ≤ C * √(Real.log (Real.log ↑m) / L m)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.fEfed_of_decay
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] [inst_3 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) {hsched : ℕ → ℝ} {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ}, Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → ∀ {k : 𝓐} {α : ℝ}, 0 ≤ α → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬AlphaRAR.aRTSFEUnder A Y θ₀ T hsched k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → Filter.Tendsto hsched Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T i ω k) / hsched n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) → (∀ (C : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => C * √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) / hsched n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ g, (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k ≤ g m) ∧ ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, g m < hsched m / ↑m) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ n₀ E, Monotone E ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ), n₀ ≤ m → A m ω = k → (¬∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → E m + 1 ≤ E (m + 1)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => E n / hsched n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.g_littleOp_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) {Q : Ω → ℕ → Prop} [inst : (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q ω)], (∀ (m : ℕ), MeasurableSet {ω | Q ω m}) → ∀ (k'' : 𝓐) {v : ℝ}, 0 < v → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) m / ↑m) Filter.atTop (nhds v)) → AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne P fun n ω => ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q ω) n) * (|AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k'' (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q ω) n) ω| + |θ₀ k'' - ν.means k''|) / ((AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q ω) n) + 1) * (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) n + 1))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.genRespMart_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (k : 𝓐) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.genRespMart ν A Y k g (n + 1) = AlphaRAR.genRespMart ν A Y k g n + fun ω => Learning.armIndicator A k n ω * (g n (Y n ω) - ∫ (x : ℝ), g n x ∂ν k)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.generic_ineq_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ (X p ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred P], (∀ (m : ℕ), ¬P m → p m ≤ α * ρ m) → (∀ (m : ℕ), p m ≤ 1) → (∀ (m : ℕ), 0 ≤ α * ρ m) → ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.count X n - ↑n * ρ n ≤ 1 + (AlphaRAR.count X (AlphaRAR.hitting P n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting P n) * ρ (AlphaRAR.hitting P n)) + (AlphaRAR.auxU X p ρ α n - AlphaRAR.auxU X p ρ α (AlphaRAR.hitting P n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.iid_hartmanWintner_limsup_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Y μ → (∀ (j : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (Y j) (Y 0) μ μ) → MeasureTheory.MemLp (Y 0) 2 μ → ∫ (ω : Ω), Y 0 ω ∂μ = 0 → 0 < ∫ (ω : Ω), Y 0 ω ^ 2 ∂μ → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.limsup (fun m => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Y j ω) / √((2 * ∫ (x : Ω), Y 0 x ^ 2 ∂μ) * ↑m * Real.log (Real.log ↑m))) Filter.atTop ≤ 1

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_lindTrunc
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} (wn : ℕ → 𝓐 → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : 𝓐), ∫ (y : ℝ), AlphaRAR.lindTrunc ν wn ε n a y ∂ν a = wn n a ^ 2 * ∫ (x : ℝ), {x | ε < |wn n a| * |x - ν.means a|}.indicator (fun x => (x - ν.means a) ^ 2) x ∂ν a

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_predQuadVar_succ_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ], MeasureTheory.Martingale M ℱ μ → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (M n) 2 μ) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ (n + 1) ω ∂μ - ∫ (ω : Ω), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n ω ∂μ = ∫ (ω : Ω), (M (n + 1) ω - M n ω) ^ 2 ∂μ

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_respMart_increment_sq_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∫ (ω : Ω), (AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k (n + 1) ω - AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_respMart_sq_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] [Finite 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (k : 𝓐), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω ^ 2 ∂P = ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * ∫ (ω : Ω), ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) ∂P

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_sq_eq_integral_predQuadVar
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ], MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted ℱ M → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (M n) 2 μ) → M 0 =ᵐ[μ] 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), M n ω ^ 2 ∂μ = ∫ (ω : Ω), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n ω ∂μ

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_sq_le_of_increment_bound

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_sq_truncation_le

entries.name: AlphaRAR.integral_truncation_sub_integral_sq_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ → ∀ (A : ℝ), ∫ (ω : Ω), (ProbabilityTheory.truncation X A ω - ∫ (x : Ω), ProbabilityTheory.truncation X A x ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ ∫ (ω : Ω), X ω ^ 2 ∂μ

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hY : ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)), ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Y μ → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (Y i) 2 μ) → ∀ (b : ℕ → ℝ) {v : ℝ}, (∀ (i : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, fun ω => ProbabilityTheory.truncation (Y j) (b j) ω - ∫ (x : Ω), ProbabilityTheory.truncation (Y j) (b j) x ∂μ) (AlphaRAR.natFiltLT (fun i ω => ProbabilityTheory.truncation (Y i) (b i) ω - ∫ (x : Ω), ProbabilityTheory.truncation (Y i) (b i) x ∂μ) ⋯) μ n ω ≤ v * ↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_genRespMart_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (k : 𝓐) {g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}, (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (g n)) → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => g n (Y n ω)) 2 P) → ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (AlphaRAR.genRespMart ν A Y k g) (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationAction ⋯ ⋯) P n =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ProbabilityTheory.variance (g i) (ν k) * Learning.armIndicator A k i ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_iidSum_ge
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hY : ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)), ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Y μ → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω ∂μ = 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (Y i) 2 μ) → ∀ {w : ℝ}, (∀ (i : ℕ), w ≤ ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), w * ↑n ≤ AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Y j) (AlphaRAR.natFiltLT Y hY) μ n ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_iidSum_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hY : ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)), ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Y μ → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω ∂μ = 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (Y i) 2 μ) → ∀ {v : ℝ}, (∀ (i : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Y j) (AlphaRAR.natFiltLT Y hY) μ n ω ≤ v * ↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_iidSum_succ_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hY : ∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (Y i)), ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Y μ → (∀ (i : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω ∂μ = 0) → (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (Y i) 2 μ) → ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Y j) (AlphaRAR.natFiltLT Y hY) μ (n + 1) - AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (fun m => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Y j) (AlphaRAR.natFiltLT Y hY) μ n =ᵐ[μ] fun x => ∫ (ω : Ω), Y n ω ^ 2 ∂μ

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_le_of_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ], MeasureTheory.Martingale M ℱ μ → ∀ {c : ℝ}, (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |M (i + 1) ω - M i ω| ≤ c) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n ω ≤ c ^ 2 * ↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_le_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Martingale M ℱ μ → ∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => M (n + 1) ω - M n ω) 2 μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (M n * (M (n + 1) - M n)) μ → AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n ≤ᵐ[μ] AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ (n + 1)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Martingale M ℱ μ → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => M (n + 1) ω - M n ω) 2 μ) → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (M n * (M (n + 1) - M n)) μ) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Monotone fun x => AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ x ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} (M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (-M) ℱ μ = AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Martingale M ℱ μ → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => M (n + 1) ω - M n ω) 2 μ) → (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (M n * (M (n + 1) - M n)) μ) → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_respMart_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] [Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (k : 𝓐), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k) (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationAction ⋯ ⋯) P n =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_stopMart_of_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} (M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (N : ℕ) {m : ℕ}, m ≤ N → AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (AlphaRAR.stopMart M N) ℱ μ m = AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ m

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_succ_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ (n + 1) - AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n = μ[(fun ω => M (n + 1) ω ^ 2) - fun ω => M n ω ^ 2 | ↑ℱ n]

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_succ_sub_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Martingale M ℱ μ → ∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => M (n + 1) ω - M n ω) 2 μ → MeasureTheory.Integrable (M n * (M (n + 1) - M n)) μ → AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ (n + 1) - AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ n =ᵐ[μ] μ[fun ω => (M (n + 1) ω - M n ω) ^ 2 | ↑ℱ n]

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_truncRespMart_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (Y n) P) → ∀ (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (AlphaRAR.truncRespMart ν A Y k) (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationAction ⋯ ⋯) P n =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, AlphaRAR.truncVar ν k i * Learning.armIndicator A k i ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_truncRespMart_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (Y n) P) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x => x) 2 (ν k) → ∀ (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.predQuadVar (AlphaRAR.truncRespMart ν A Y k) (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationAction ⋯ ⋯) P n ≤ᵐ[P] fun ω => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Learning.armIndicator A k i ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predQuadVar_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} {M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, AlphaRAR.predQuadVar M ℱ μ 0 = 0

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predVar_respArray_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (hνk : ∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) (k : 𝓐) (vk : ℝ), 0 ≤ vk → 0 ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) → ∀ (n : ℕ), (AlphaRAR.respArray h hνk k vk).predVar n =ᵐ[P] fun ω => (ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * vk * ↑n)⁻¹ * (ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predVar_wArray_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_4 : Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (hνk : ∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) (wn : ℕ → 𝓐 → ℝ) (n : ℕ), (AlphaRAR.wArray h hνk wn).predVar n =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ a, wn n a ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) * AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.predVar_wArray_scaled_ae
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_4 : Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (hνk : ∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) (w : 𝓐 → ℝ) {c : 𝓐 → ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ c a n) → ∀ (n : ℕ), (AlphaRAR.wArray h hνk fun n a => w a / √(c a n)).predVar n =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∑ a, w a ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a) * (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n / c a n)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.preliminary_ineq
entries.statement: ∀ (X p ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (n ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ n → p ℓ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ α * ρ ℓ → (∀ m ∈ Finset.Ico (ℓ + 1) n, p m ≤ α * ρ m) → AlphaRAR.count X n - ↑n * ρ n ≤ 1 + (AlphaRAR.count X ℓ - ↑ℓ * ρ ℓ) + (AlphaRAR.auxU X p ρ α n - AlphaRAR.auxU X p ρ α ℓ)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.preliminary_small
entries.statement: ∀ (X ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [inst : DecidablePred P] (n : ℕ), (∀ (m : ℕ), P m → AlphaRAR.count X m ≤ ↑m * ρ m) → AlphaRAR.count X (AlphaRAR.hitting P n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting P n) * ρ (AlphaRAR.hitting P n) ≤ 0

entries.name: AlphaRAR.probVecKernel
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → [inst : MeasurableSpace X] → [Fintype 𝓐] → [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] → (p : X → 𝓐 → ℝ) → (∀ (a : 𝓐), Measurable fun x => p x a) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel X 𝓐

entries.name: AlphaRAR.probVecKernel_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] (p : X → 𝓐 → ℝ) (hp : ∀ (a : 𝓐), Measurable fun x => p x a) (x : X), (AlphaRAR.probVecKernel p hp) x = ∑ a, ENNReal.ofReal (p x a) • MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac a

entries.name: AlphaRAR.probVecKernel_apply_singleton
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] (p : X → 𝓐 → ℝ) (hp : ∀ (a : 𝓐), Measurable fun x => p x a) (x : X) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ p x k → (((AlphaRAR.probVecKernel p hp) x) {k}).toReal = p x k

entries.name: AlphaRAR.propSqrtNVec
entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (𝓐 → ℝ) → ℕ → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ 𝓐

entries.name: AlphaRAR.prop_dev
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] {Dev small Uincr Mincr rhoterm pert d : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ι → ℝ} {VM WM Vρ Wρ : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), ∑ k, Dev k n ω = 0) → (∀ (k : ι) (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Dev k n ω ≤ small k n ω + Uincr k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => max (small k n ω / √↑n) 0) → (∀ (k : ι), 0 < c k) → (∀ (k : ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ d k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Uincr k n ω ≤ -c k * d k n ω + Mincr k n ω + rhoterm k n ω + pert k n ω * d k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ (pert k)) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Mincr k n ω ≤ VM k n ω * d k n ω + WM k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ (VM k)) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => WM k n ω / √↑n) → (∀ (k : ι), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, rhoterm k n ω ≤ Vρ k n ω * d k n ω + Wρ k n ω) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ (Vρ k)) → (∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => Wρ k n ω / √↑n) → ∀ (k : ι), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => Dev k n ω / √↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.prop_dev_ae_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_3 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, α < 1 → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n k'' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k'') n) Filter.atTop (nhds ν.means)) → ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst_4 : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k' : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => T (fun k'' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k'' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k'') n) k' - T ν.means k') =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) / ↑n) → (∀ (k' : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ C, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k' ω) n) ω k' ≤ C * √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) - ↑n * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T n ω k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.prop_dev_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_3 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, α < 1 → ∀ {K : NNReal}, LipschitzWith K T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) Filter.atTop (nhds ν.means)) → (∀ (k' : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (T ν.means k'))) → ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst_4 : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), MeasurableSet {ω | Q k ω m}) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne P fun n ω => max ((1 + (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) ω k)) / √↑n) 0) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne P fun n ω => (↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) - ↑n * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T n ω k) / √↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.proportion_pos_of_condB
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ u, ∀ (k : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (fun k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) k) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k))) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ u, (∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < u k) ∧ ∀ (k : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.proportion_tendsto_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_3 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst_4 : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) ω k) / ↑n < δ) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (T ν.means k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.pullCount_div_sched_tendsto_one
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_1 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, AlphaRAR.IsExplorationSchedule hsched → (∀ (m : ℕ), (∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → ↑(Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω) ≤ hsched m ∧ ∀ (j : 𝓐), ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m → Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A j m ω) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => hsched (n - (Fintype.card 𝓐 * ⌈hsched n⌉₊ + 1)) / hsched n) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) → ∀ {k : 𝓐} {n₀ : ℕ} (E : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone E → (∀ (m : ℕ), n₀ ≤ m → A m ω = k → (¬∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → E m + 1 ≤ E (m + 1)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => E n / hsched n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) / hsched n) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.pullCount_ge_min_sched_of_fe
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} [inst : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_1 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, Monotone hsched → (∀ (m : ℕ), (∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → ↑(Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω) ≤ hsched m ∧ ∀ (j : 𝓐), ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m → Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A j m ω) → ∀ {s n L : ℕ}, Fintype.card 𝓐 * L < n - s → ∀ (j : 𝓐), min (↑L) (hsched s) ≤ ↑(Learning.pullCount A j n ω)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.pullCount_le_sched_of_fe_except
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (ω : Ω) {hsched : ℕ → ℝ}, Monotone hsched → (∀ (m : ℕ), (∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → ↑(Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω) ≤ hsched m ∧ ∀ (j : 𝓐), ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m → Learning.pullCount A (A m ω) m ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A j m ω) → ∀ {k : 𝓐} {n₀ : ℕ} (E : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone E → (∀ (m : ℕ), n₀ ≤ m → A m ω = k → (¬∃ j, ↑(Learning.pullCount A j m ω) ≤ hsched m) → E m + 1 ≤ E (m + 1)) → ∀ {n : ℕ}, n₀ ≤ n → ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) ≤ max (↑(Learning.pullCount A k n₀ ω)) (hsched n + 1) + (E n - E n₀)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.qm_increments_of_bdd
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ mΩ} {N : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, MeasureTheory.Martingale N ℱ μ → N 0 =ᵐ[μ] 0 → ∀ {c : ℝ}, (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |N (n + 1) ω - N n ω| ≤ c) → AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ (AlphaRAR.vmaxSeq fun x => N) ∧ AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne μ fun n ω => AlphaRAR.wmaxSeq (fun x => N) n ω / √↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.qm_increments_resp
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ}, Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne P (AlphaRAR.vmaxSeq fun k => AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k) ∧ AlphaRAR.IsLittleOpOne P fun n ω => AlphaRAR.wmaxSeq (fun k => AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k) n ω / √↑n

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (k : 𝓐), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω / ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_div_sqrt_tendsto_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (k : 𝓐) (vk : ℝ), 0 < vk → 0 < ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds vk)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (√(ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * vk * ↑n))⁻¹ * AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1, ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_eq_sum_sampledSeq

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_increment_mul_eq_zero

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_joint_selfNorm_tendsto_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_4 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {c : 𝓐 → ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ c a n) → (∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (c a) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) → ∀ {v : 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐), 0 < v a) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n / c a n) Filter.atTop (nhds (v a))) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => (√(AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n))⁻¹ * AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y a n ω) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.diagonal fun a => ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a)), ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_joint_tendsto_multivariateGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_4 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {c : 𝓐 → ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ c a n) → (∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (c a) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) → ∀ {ρ : 𝓐 → ℝ}, (∀ (a : 𝓐), 0 ≤ ρ a) → (∀ (a : 𝓐), 0 ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a)) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (a : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A a j ω) n / c a n) Filter.atTop (nhds (ρ a))) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.map ⟨P, ⋯⟩ ⋯) Filter.atTop (nhds (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.map ⟨ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (Matrix.diagonal fun a => ρ a * ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν a)), ⋯⟩ ⋯))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_selfNorm_anscombe_tendsto
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (k : 𝓐), (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, {j | A j ω = k}.Infinite) → MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν k) → ∀ {c : ℕ → ℕ}, Filter.Tendsto c Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω) / ↑(c n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (√↑(Learning.pullCount A k n ω))⁻¹ * AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k)).toNNReal, ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_selfNorm_tendsto_gaussianReal
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (k : 𝓐) (vk : ℝ), 0 < vk → 0 < ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) → (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds vk)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => (√(ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) n))⁻¹ * AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω) P, ⋯⟩) Filter.atTop (nhds ⟨ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1, ⋯⟩)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k (n + 1) = AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n + fun ω => Learning.armIndicator A k n ω * (Y n ω - ν.means k)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.respMart_succ_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k (n + 1) ω - AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω = Learning.armIndicator A k n ω * (Y n ω - ν.means k)

entries.name: AlphaRAR.rho_converges
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ u, ∀ (k : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (fun k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) k) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.rho_converges_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [Finite 𝓐] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ (θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ) (T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ), Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∃ u, (∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < u k) ∧ ∀ (k : 𝓐), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (fun k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) k) Filter.atTop (nhds (u k))

entries.name: AlphaRAR.rho_rate
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [Finite 𝓐] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {θ θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ}, DifferentiableAt ℝ T θ → ∀ {r : ℕ → ℝ}, (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) Filter.atTop (nhds θ)) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k) n - θ k) =O[Filter.atTop] r) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => T (fun k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) k - T θ k) =O[Filter.atTop] r

entries.name: AlphaRAR.rho_rate_of_hitting
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P), (∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) → ∀ {θ₀ : 𝓐 → ℝ} {T : (𝓐 → ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ}, Continuous T → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ) (k : 𝓐), 0 ≤ T z k) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), ∑ k, T z k = 1) → ∀ {α : ℝ}, α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → ∀ (Q : 𝓐 → Ω → ℕ → Prop) [inst : (k : 𝓐) → (ω : Ω) → DecidablePred (Q k ω)], (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (m : ℕ), ¬Q k ω m → AlphaRAR.aRTSSelProb A k (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration ⋯ ⋯) P m ω ≤ α * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T m ω k) → (∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (AlphaRAR.count (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k j ω) (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) - ↑(AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) * AlphaRAR.aRTSTarget A Y θ₀ T (AlphaRAR.hitting (Q k ω) n) ω k) / ↑n < δ) → (∀ (z : 𝓐 → ℝ), (∀ (k : 𝓐), z k ∈ AlphaRAR.attainableSet A Y (θ₀ k) k) → ∀ (k : 𝓐), 0 < T z k) → DifferentiableAt ℝ T ν.means → ∀ (k : 𝓐), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, (fun n => T (fun k' => AlphaRAR.estimator (fun j => Learning.armIndicator A k' j ω) (fun x => Y x ω) (θ₀ k') n) k - T ν.means k) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => √(↑n * Real.log (Real.log ↑n)) / ↑n

entries.name: AlphaRAR.rowSum_respArray
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_3 : Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (hνk : ∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) (k : 𝓐) (vk : ℝ) (n : ℕ), (AlphaRAR.respArray h hνk k vk).rowSum n = fun ω => (√(ProbabilityTheory.variance id (ν k) * vk * ↑n))⁻¹ * AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y k n ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.rowSum_wArray
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} [inst : MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] [inst_1 : Fintype 𝓐] {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_4 : Finite 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A Y alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (hνk : ∀ (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.MemLp id 2 (ν a)) (wn : ℕ → 𝓐 → ℝ) (n : ℕ), (AlphaRAR.wArray h hνk wn).rowSum n = fun ω => ∑ a, wn n a * AlphaRAR.respMart ν A Y a n ω

entries.name: AlphaRAR.sampleTime_eq_iff

entries.name: AlphaRAR.sampleTime_strictMono

entries.name: AlphaRAR.smul_measure_sup_le_integral_zero

entries.name: AlphaRAR.MartDiffArray.condExp_Zproc_increment
